verses.text: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are in Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:
Grace and peace be unto you from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

sections.title: The Prayer of Saint Paul for the Philippians.

verses.text: I give thanks to my God always in every remembrance of you.
I pray for you constantly; I also offer prayers of joy.
From the first day until now, you have been partakers with me in the gospel.
I am confident that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
It is right for me to think this of you, because you hold me in your heart, for you are all partakers of grace with me in my imprisonment and in the defense and confirmation of the gospel.
The Lord is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight.

So that you may be able to discern what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ, filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
I pray that you may be filled with the fruit of righteousness which comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

sections.title: In the Holy Gospel of Saint Paul, as it is written.

verses.text: Brothers, I love you, for you know that this has come to me to spread the true Gospel.
Concerning the name of Christ, it is known among all and before every man.
Many of our brothers, by my imprisonment, have become confident in the Lord; and they are teaching the word of God without fear, and thus they have greatly increased.
Among them, some, by their boldness and their disputes, and others, by their good will, have desired to join me and to teach me concerning Christ.
They are teaching in love; for they know how I have been appointed to teach the Gospel.
Yet, those who teach concerning Christ, this they do, thinking that they may add to my affliction in my imprisonment; but in truth, it is not so; nor is it in sincerity.
But what does it matter? Whether in truth or in falsehood, they speak of Christ; and they call all men to Him; and in this, I rejoice; and in the future, I shall rejoice.
I also know that this work, through your prayers and in the Spirit of Jesus Christ, shall lead me to life.

For I do not know what I shall choose; I am in a strait between the two, having a desire to depart and to be with Christ, which is far better; yet if I remain in the flesh, this is more needful for you.
For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
But if I live in the flesh, this is the fruit of my labor; yet what I shall choose, I cannot tell.
I am in a dilemma between the two; I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better for me; nevertheless, to remain in the flesh is more necessary for you.
And also, for your sake, to remain in the flesh is more profitable.

I believe that this will turn out for my deliverance through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, according to my earnest expectation and hope that in nothing I shall be ashamed.
Now, if I come to you again, may the glory that you receive in Jesus Christ abound to you.
However, if I should come as I am, not being present, but being in the Gospel of faith, may you stand fast in one spirit and one mind, striving together for the faith of the Gospel.
Their destruction, and your life, will be known, so do not be troubled by those who oppose you.
This grace has been bestowed upon you by the Lord; however, it is for the purpose of enduring trials for His sake, and not merely to believe in Him.
Likewise, do not treat me as an adversary; as you have heard my matters, be ever vigilant against them.

sections.title: Concerning the pride of the heart.

verses.text: አሁንም በክርስቶስ ደስታ፥ ወይም በፍቅር የልብ መጽናናት፥ ወይም የመንፈስ አንድነት፥ ወይም ማዘንና መራራትም በእናንተ ዘንድ ካለ፦
እርሱን ብቻ ታስቡ ዘንድ፥ አንድ ልብና አንድ ምክርም ሆናችሁ፥ በፍቅር ትኖሩ ዘንድ ደስታዬን ፈጽሙልኝ።
በክርክርና ከንቱ ውዳሴን በመውደድ አትሥሩ፤ ትሕትናን በያዘ ልቡና ከራሳችሁ ይልቅ ባልንጀራችሁን አክብሩ እንጂ አትታበዩ።
ለባልንጀራችሁም እንጂ ለየራሳችሁ ብቻ አታስቡ።
ፍጹማን የሆናችሁ ሁላችሁ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ለእኛ እንደ አደረገልን ይህን አስቡ።
ይኸውም የእግዚአብሔር መልኩ ነው፤ ቀምቶ እግዚአብሔር የሆነ አይደለም።
ነገር ግን የባርያን መልክ ይዞ፥ በሰውም ምሳሌ ሆኖ ራሱን ዝቅ አደረገ።
እንደ ሰውም ሆኖ ራሱን አዋረደ፤ ለሞት እስከ መድረስም ታዘዘ፤ ሞቱም በመስቀል የሆነው ነው።
ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር እጅግ ከፍ ከፍ አደረገው፤ ከስም ሁሉ የሚበልጥ ስምንም ሰጠው።
ይህም በሰማይና በምድር በቀላያትና ከምድር በታች ያለ ጕልበት ሁሉ ለኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስም ይሰግድ ዘንድ ነው።
And indeed, all shall believe that Jesus Christ is Lord in the glory of God the Father.
Now, brethren, as you hear me, let it not be only while I am present, but also in my absence, that you may be in fear and trembling for your own salvation.
He who assists you in the work you love, may the Lord God grant you His mercy.
In all that you do, perform it without murmuring and without disputing, in love and in unity.
As children of God, be pure and blameless, that you may shine as lights in the world, amidst those who do not believe and among the children of disobedience.
As you are taught the word of life, let me be with you on the day of Christ, for my labor is not in vain, nor is my suffering in vain.
Concerning your faith, I shall offer my prayers. Behold, I rejoice in you.
And you also rejoice in me. Make joy with me.

sections.title: Concerning Timothy and the angel of Aphrodite.

verses.text: I rejoice in the news of you, as I remember you in my prayers, and I place my hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.
Apart from him, there is none who can fulfill your needs as I do.
He who is not of Christ considers only his own affairs.
Just as a son serves his father, so I have served you in the teachings of the Gospel; you know this man’s service.
Therefore, how I am now, I hope to be as I was in the past.
I too believe that I will come swiftly in our Lord.
Now I have thought to send to you our brother Aphroditus, who is a servant of Christ; he is your teacher and my messenger in times of trouble.
As you have heard of my afflictions, it would be good for you to listen to my voice.
But the Lord God is merciful; may He not add sorrow upon sorrow to me, not only for me but for him as well.
That you may see and rejoice, I will send to you soon, so that I may not be sorrowful.
Therefore, receive with utmost joy from our Lord; and honor all those who are like this.
Concerning the work of the Lord, I have labored unto death; and the message I have delivered to you shall be fulfilled, for He has given His body as a sacrifice.

sections.title: Concerning the teaching that brings forth abundance.

verses.text: Now, brethren, rejoice in our Lord; I do not speak to you with heaviness, for He has strengthened you.
Beware of dogs; beware of evil workers; beware of those who mutilate the flesh.
We are those who serve the Lord God in spirit and who look to Him; and we believe in Jesus Christ, not in the flesh.
I do not boast in my flesh; if there is one who boasts in the flesh, I will boast in him.
On the eighth day, I was circumcised; I am of the people of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; as to the law, I was a Pharisee.
In the flesh, I was blameless, but I was zealous for the faith of the believers.
However, concerning Christ, I have counted that gain as loss.
I have served Christ, and I have considered all things as loss, for the sake of knowing my Lord Jesus Christ, and I have counted them as rubbish.
In Him, I stand; today, without righteousness in the flesh, I have the righteousness that comes from God through faith in Christ.
In Him, I know Jesus Christ; I have the power of His resurrection, and I share in His sufferings, becoming like Him in His death.
Behold, when the dead shall rise, perhaps it is as I have found in this matter.
ነገር ግን ይህን ፈጽሜ የተቀበልሁ አይደለም፤ ኢየሱስ ክርስቶስ ስለ እርሱ እኔን የመረጠበትን አገኝ ዘንድ እሮጣለሁ እንጂ።
ወንድሞች ሆይ፥ እኔ ግን ፍጻሜዬን ገና ያገኘሁ አይመስለኝም።
የኋላዬን እረሳለሁና፥ ወደ ፊቴም ፈጥኜ እገሠግሣለሁና፤ በኢየሱስ ክርስቶስም ከፍ ከፍ ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን የጥሪ ዋጋ ለማግኘት ወደ ግቡ እፈጥናለሁ።
Consider this, all of you who are perfect; even if there be another thought in your hearts, the Lord God shall reveal it unto you.
However, let us be united in the work that we have been called to do.
Brethren, I beseech you; as you walk in this manner, let us be watchful over one another, as we were in times past.
As I speak to you continually, there are many who walk in a different manner; even now, I declare unto you that they are the enemies of the cross of Christ.
These are they whose end is destruction, whose god is their belly, and whose glory is in their shame; they mind earthly things.
Our citizenship is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ.
He shall transform our lowly body, that it may be fashioned like unto His glorious body, according to the working whereby He is able even to subdue all things unto Himself.
Now, beloved brethren, who are our joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord; my beloved.
I urge Euodia and I urge Syntyche to be of the same mind in the Lord.
I entreat you, my true companion, help these women who have labored side by side with me in the gospel together with Clement and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.
Rejoice in the Lord always; again I will say, Rejoice.
Let your reasonableness be known to everyone. The Lord is at hand;
Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus.

Finally, brethren, whatever is true, whatever is honorable, whatever is just, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is commendable, if there is any excellence, if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.
What you have learned and received and heard and seen in me—practice these things, and the God of peace will be with you.

sections.title: Praise for the deeds of the Philippians.

verses.text: I am greatly rejoiced in our Lord; even if you think of me now as you did from the beginning, consider me a burden from the outset, for I was indeed troubled.
This I say not because I seek a gift; for I know that which I have is sufficient for me.
I am able to endure both my troubles and my needs; I can do all things through Him who strengthens me, and I rejoice in all things.
I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.
Yet, in the time of my affliction, you have been good to be my partners.
You Philippians, at the beginning of my ministry when I came from Macedonia, you alone were my partners in giving and receiving, and you know that no other church shared with me in this matter.
Even when I was in Thessalonica, you sent once and again to meet my needs.
Not that I seek the gift, but I seek the fruit that abounds to your account.
But I have all and abound; I am full, having received from Epaphroditus the things sent from you, a sweet-smelling aroma, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
My God shall supply all your needs according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
Glory be to our Father, to God, for eternity. Amen.
In Jesus Christ, let all the saints greet you with peace; and may our brethren who are with me also send you their greetings of peace.
And all the saints, especially those of Caesar's household, send you their greetings of peace.
The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all; Amen.
